blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We investigate whether continued pretraining on Russian legislative documents improves a Russian ModernBERT encoder on legal text. The adapted model, RuModernBERT-ruLaw, was trained on a corpus reported to contain 304,382 legislative documents and 194,425,905 corpus tokens. Corpus token counts are distinguished from positions produced by the model tokenizer. We compare the original and adapted encoders on a fixed external collection of 1,031 court-decision segments. Both models receive the same hidden positions in each of five masking realizations. At maximum input lengths of 512, 2,048, and 8,192 tokens, mean masked-token cross-entropy decreases by 0.10942, 0.07052, and 0.06604 natural-log units, respectively. The reported 95% intervals summarize sensitivity to masking on this fixed collection; they do not quantify uncertainty across document collections. A second evaluation addresses legal-entity extraction. The original and adapted models achieve entity-level F 1 F_{1} scores of 0.99852 and 0.99820. However, 99.95% of test spans have the same normalized surface form and class in the training split. This evaluation therefore provides limited evidence about transfer to previously unseen forms. The paper explains the masking objective, overlapping windows, averaging rules, and exact entity-boundary scoring using editable diagrams and clearly marked illustrative examples. The comparison supports lower masked-token prediction loss for the studied pair of models and collection. It does not isolate the contribution of distant context or establish practical legal utility.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In a long legal document, an important condition and a reference to it may be far apart. A model needs to account for words and relationships between document sections to locate relevant passages. Legal language also contains specialized terms and fixed expressions. We continue pretraining a general Russian-language model on legislative texts and evaluate changes in two tasks: predicting hidden tokens and extracting legal spans.
blocks.zh: 在一份冗长的法律文件中,一个重要条件和提及它可能相去甚远。 一个模型需要考虑文字和文件部分之间的关系,以定位相关的段落. 法律语言还包含专门术语和固定表达. 我们继续就立法文本对一般俄语模式进行预先培训,并评估两项任务的变化:预测隐藏的标志和提取法律跨度。

blocks.en: A bidirectional encoder transforms input text into contextual vector representations of its positions using both left and right context. Text is first split into tokens; a rare or complex word may consist of several tokens representing parts of the word. BERT-family encoders remain a practical basis for classification, retrieval, and entity extraction [ 1 ] . In masked language modeling, some tokens are hidden. The loss for one hidden token is − ln ⁡ p -\ln p , where p p is the probability assigned by the model to its correct original value.
blocks.zh: 双向编码器将输入文本转换为上下文矢量表示其位置,同时使用左上下文和右上下文. 文本先被拆分为符;一个稀有或复杂的单词可能由代表单词部分的几个符所组成. BERT-家族编码器仍然是分类、检索和实体提取的实际基础[1]。 在蒙面语言模特中,一些活字被隐藏. 一个隐藏符号的损失是 − in {} p-\ln p, 其中p 是模型为其正确的原始值指定的概率 。

blocks.en: General pretraining does not guarantee accurate modeling of language in a particular domain. Continued pretraining on an unlabeled domain corpus, commonly called domain-adaptive pretraining, has systematically improved representations in several domains [ 2 ] . In the legal domain, LEGAL-BERT compared a general model, continued pretraining, and training from scratch across legal NLP tasks [ 3 ] . Most early legal encoders, however, support only short inputs.
blocks.zh: 一般预训并不能保证特定领域语言的准确模型化. 继续就一个没有标签的域名进行预先培训,通常称为域-适应性预先培训,有系统地改进了几个域的表述[2]。 在法律领域,Law-BERT比较了一般性模式、持续预训和从头到尾的NLP任务[3]。 然而,大多数早期的法律编码员只支持简短的投入.

blocks.en: This study investigates domain adaptation of RuModernBERT-base to Russian legislation while retaining the standard ModernBERT maximum input length of 8192 tokens. The main evaluation uses a court-decision collection that differs from the training corpus in source and document type. Possible content overlap or paraphrased overlap was not specifically excluded. We therefore describe this evaluation as external, rather than independent.
blocks.zh: 本研究调查了RuModernBERT-base在保留标准ModernBERT最大输入长度为8192令牌的同时,对俄罗斯立法的域名进行修改. 主要评价采用法庭裁决汇编,在来源和文件类型上不同于培训汇编。 没有具体排除可能的内容重叠或所诠释的重叠。 因此,我们把这一评价说成是外部的,而不是独立的。

blocks.en: The study addresses three bounded questions. Does continued pretraining reduce cross-entropy at randomly masked positions in external court-decision fragments? Does the direction of the effect persist at maximum input lengths of 512, 2048, and 8192 tokens? Does the available legal-span extraction task distinguish the original and adapted encoders after exact duplicate texts are removed?
blocks.zh: 这项研究涉及三个有限度的问题。 继续预先训练是否减少了在外部法庭裁决碎片中随机遮住位置的交叉接触? 效果的方向是否持续了最高输入长度为512,2048,和8192个符? 在删除确切的重复文本之后,现有的法律-span提取任务是否区分了原始和经过调整的编码器?

blocks.en:
The main result is lower masked-token cross-entropy for the adapted model at every tested length and masking realization. Comparing lengths does not isolate a causal effect of distant context because the prefix composition and evaluated tokens also change. Both models achieved F 1 > 0.998 F_{1}>0.998 in span extraction, but nearly complete coverage of test forms by training forms limits the discriminative value of this experiment. The study evaluates model losses and one entity-extraction test. It does not assess legal expertise or practical labor savings.

blocks.en: 1.1 Interpreting model evaluations
blocks.zh: 1.1 解释评价模式

blocks.en: The training task resembles filling gaps in a sentence: the model estimates the probabilities of the original hidden tokens from surrounding text. These probabilities are converted into a numerical loss. A higher probability for the correct token gives a lower loss. Entity extraction poses a different task: locating the boundaries of a relevant text passage and assigning its class. These evaluations assess different model capabilities.
blocks.zh: 培训任务类似于在句子中填补空白:模型估计了原始隐藏符从周围文本中的概率. 这些概率被转换成数字损失。 正确信使的概率越高,损失就越小。 实体提取任务不同:查找相关文本段落的边界并分配其类别。 这些评价评估了不同的模型能力。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Domain adaptation of legal models
blocks.zh: 2.1 法律模式的领域调整

blocks.en: Continued pretraining separates learning general language patterns from adaptation to the distribution of a target corpus [ 2 ] . LEGAL-BERT showed that the choice between using a general model, continuing pretraining, and training from scratch requires experimental evaluation: recommendations from a general domain do not always transfer to legal tasks [ 3 ] . The later MultiLegalPile corpus combined material in 24 languages from 17 jurisdictions and was used to train RoBERTa and Longformer models, emphasizing both language and jurisdictional specificity [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 继续预训将学习一般语言模式与目标体的分布区分开来[2]. Law-BERT表明,在使用一般模式、继续预训和从零开始的培训之间作出选择需要进行实验性评价:一般领域的建议并不总是转移到法律任务[3]。 后来的多法律规则综合了来自17个法域的24种语言的材料,用于培训RoBERTa和Longformer模型,强调语言和管辖权的特殊性[4]。

blocks.en: The Russian Legislative Corpus (RusLawOD) is an important source for Russian. Version 3 of arXiv:2406.04855, dated 27 April 2026, describes a 1991–2025 snapshot containing 304 382 documents and 194 425 905 tokens [ 5 ] . The corpus is available through Hugging Face [ 6 ] . These statistics refer to the snapshot described in version 3.
blocks.zh: 俄罗斯立法公司(RuslawOD)是俄语的重要来源. arXiv:2406.0485 第3版于2026年4月27日出道,描述了一幅1991–2025年的快照,包含304,382份文件和194,425,905个令牌 [5]. 炸弹通过Hugging Face[6]提供。 这些统计参考了第3版所描述的快照.

blocks.en: 2.2 Long-context encoders
blocks.zh: 2.2 长文本编码器

blocks.en: Full self-attention has quadratic cost in sequence length. Longformer combines local sliding-window attention with designated global attention, yielding linear scaling for most operations [ 7 ] . Based on this architecture, Lawformer was further pretrained on Chinese court documents of up to 4096 tokens and improved performance on tasks involving long legal texts [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 完全自觉在序列长度上具有四重成本. Longformer将本地的滑窗关注与指定的全球关注相结合,为大多数操作产生线性缩放[7]. 基于这一架构,Lawformer进一步接受了4096个代币的中国法院文件的预先培训,并改进了涉及长篇法律文本的任务的绩效[8].

blocks.en: ModernBERT develops the bidirectional encoder with a standard context length of 8192 tokens, alternating global and local attention, rotary positional representations, and modern computational optimizations [ 9 ] . The model studied here adapts ModernBERT to Russian legislation and separately checks whether the adaptation effect persists at three input lengths.
blocks.zh: ModernBERT开发了双向编码器,标准上下文长度为8192个令牌,交替全球和地方关注,旋转位置表示,现代计算优化[9]. 这里所研究的模式使ModernBERT适应了俄罗斯的立法,并分别检查了适应效应是否持续了三个输入长度.

During sequential model execution, peak memory may contain only the current layer matrix and omit the layer-count factor. The FlashAttention estimate concerns attention working memory. The experimental materials provide no measured training duration, throughput, or peak memory. The table therefore describes asymptotic scaling rather than a measured advantage of this run.

blocks.en: Attention connects token positions: information from other positions contributes to the representation of one position. A local layer restricts these connections to neighbors; a global layer connects all pairs. Figure 3.2 represents these patterns as a narrow band and a full square. At fixed local-window width, doubling length approximately doubles the local pair count and quadruples the global pair count. Positions at the boundaries have fewer neighbors, which explains the approximation. The asymptotic estimates are given in Eq. ( 2 ) and Table 3.1 .

blocks.en: 5.3 Evaluation boundaries
blocks.zh: 5.3 评价界限

blocks.en: The MLM result is restricted to the pair RuModernBERT-base–RuModernBERT-ruLaw, a fixed collection, and five masks. Semantic overlap between corpora, training variability, and transfer to other collections were not evaluated. Changing L L changes both available context and target tokens; the contribution of distant dependencies is not separated from prefix composition.
blocks.zh: MLM结果仅限于一对RuModernBERT-base-RuModernBERT-ruLaw,一个固定的收藏,以及五个口罩. 没有评价公司、培训可变性和转至其他收藏之间的语义重叠。 改变 L 既改变可用的上下文,也改变目标符号;远端依赖性的贡献不与前缀组成相分离.

blocks.en: The NER test is almost entirely covered by familiar forms. Window-level seqeval evaluation without overlap merging is not equivalent to recovering character intervals in complete documents. There is no comparison with alternative encoders under an equal budget. Complexity estimates describe operation scaling rather than a measured advantage in runtime or total training memory.
blocks.zh: NER测试几乎全部被熟悉的表格所覆盖. 窗口级后继评价没有重叠合并,并不等于在完整的文档中恢复字符间隔. 与预算相等的替代编码器没有可比性。 复杂度估计描述的是业务规模,而不是运行时间或全部训练内存中衡量的优势.

blocks.en: 5.4 Reproducible evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 5.4 可复制的评价协议

blocks.en: Reproducing the MLM comparison requires fixed model, tokenizer, and data versions, retained fragment identifiers, and inputs with identical masking and token replacements for each model pair. Losses are averaged first over hidden positions within a fragment, then equally over fragments and five masks according to Eqs. ( 3 )–( 6 ). For NER, the evaluation unit is a window: exact token boundaries and entity class are checked in BIO sequences.
blocks.zh: 复制MLM比较需要固定的模型,活化剂,和数据版本,所保留的片段识别器,以及每个模型配对具有相同遮盖和活化物替换的输入. 根据Eqs(3 ) — (6 ) , 损失首先在碎片内的隐藏位置上平均,然后在碎片和5个口罩上平均。 对于NER,评价单位是一个窗口:精确的符号边界和实体类别以BIO序列进行检查。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: After continued pretraining of Russian ModernBERT on 304 382 legislative documents, mean masked-token cross-entropy on the fixed external court-fragment collection was lower in all 15 combinations of three maximum input lengths and five masks. At L = 8192 L=8192 , the mean paired difference was 0.06604 nats. The intervals describe sensitivity to masking on this collection; the causal contribution of distant context is not isolated.

blocks.en:
In the window-level span extraction task, the adapted model had slightly lower F 1 F_{1} than the baseline: 0.99820 0.99820 versus 0.99852 0.99852 . Almost complete lexical coverage of the test split and a single run per model limit conclusions about transfer and the stability of this difference. The study provides evidence of improved MLM evaluation for the model pair examined, but establishes neither an NER advantage nor practical usefulness for legal expertise.
